title: Can not display inject glucose value as time difference too great
symptom: After about 14 hours of working, xDrip stops collecting glucose values and the event log shows 'can not display inject glucose value as time difference too great'. Restarting the collector sometimes works for 10 minutes, and reinstalling xDrip works for another 14 hours.
cause: The issue is likely caused by incorrect time on the Freestyle Libre scanner, which may be transferred to the sensor clock when activating a new sensor, leading to a time difference that xDrip detects.
fix: Correct the time on the Freestyle Libre scanner to match the actual time. The user reported that after correcting the time, everything worked great. Additionally, it was suggested to use the Glimp S app to initialize sensors, which avoids the need for a separate scanner and potential time divergence.
evidence_quote: Yes it's very likely the issue is your scanner time. Are you still having issues since that was corrected?
